name: Figura serpentinata
summary: A figure that twists along its height like a snake, with hips, shoulders and head turned in different directions.
how: Turn the hips, the shoulders and the head each 30 to 90 degrees from the one below.
Stretch the body to 9 or 10 heads tall.
Put the weight on one leg, so that the figure seems to spiral up.

origin.note: Late works of Michelangelo and the painters after him twist figures in a spiral; Lomazzo names the idea in 1584.

adoptions.via: El Greco stretches and twists his figures in tall altarpieces in Toledo.
